question: Can a man/zone actor preserve its existing football goal while making an achievable short adjustment around acquired stationary teammate traffic, including a multi-body cluster?
demonstratedMechanism: Matching a stationary peer transverse velocity alone proposes no lateral departure on a head-on approach. Single-disc lower-bound ranking/side retention still stalls in the cluster. Joint represented disc geometry plus short achievable-command ranking and gather pace solves this staged sequence.

change.proposal: trafficPath proposes an initial direction from visible tangent lines and exposed arcs of the union of up to10 acquired physical touch discs, with existing caller field bounds. Covered overlap seams cannot become free shortcuts.
change.selection: trafficRoute uses raw/restricted/gather paces in that geometry-derived direction; same existing facing/posture/effort and coverage containment; scores actual .6s free-World endpoints by remaining represented joint path distance, rejecting falls or worse peer interference.
change.retention: Only whether the actor is maneuvering is retained; peer motion is reread from this tick's acquired pictures. Missing/invalid data, changed goal geometry, or direct route clears optional routing.
change.scope: Existing eligible free man/zone actors and existing command-local own goals only; no role-wide policy expansion, private peer state, body-radius change, physics/capability change or new observation policy.
change.limit: Static represented geometry proposes actions and ranks progress; it does not certify all possible physical paths or future teammate motion. The ordinary controller remains fallback when the optional route is unavailable.
change.contactGuard: In addition to no worse minimum penetration, reject an action that increases normal relative closing speed at the first predicted touch with any acquired teammate, measured from the same achieved preview. This is a risk comparison, not delivered impulse prediction; it can still admit contact and adds no tuned clearance bubble.
